resolution: See-through nugs diagnosed and fixed: the surface-nets mesher wound triangles clockwise-from-outside while the scene3d pipeline culls backfaces with front_face=ccw (framework/gpu/3d.zig:3378), so camera-facing triangles were discarded — the user was seeing the interior of the far shell. Flipped the quad emission order in scripts/nug-gen.js and added a per-bake winding audit (triangle geometric normal dotted with the SDF gradient at the centroid; bake hard-fails under 99% outward). All four packages regenerated at 99.8% outward and recommitted.
